user_query: Compare the types of network properties emphasized by DeepWalk and LINE: which method is presented as exploiting missing information well, and which method explicitly models both observed ties and shared-neighborhood similarity?
llm_response: DeepWalk is the method presented as exploiting missing information well, while LINE is the method that explicitly models both observed ties (first-order proximity) and shared-neighborhood similarity (second-order proximity).
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard descriptions of the two methods in the network embedding literature, and the distinction is explicit and well-established.
